plan.title: Award Entire Lot to One Vendor

steps.note: Open the single-stage creation flow for a lot-based award configuration.
Enable the required lot-based awarding configuration before creating the event.
Configure the event to award the entire lot to a single vendor.
Apply the first available pricing template before adding line items.
Add multiple line items so the lot-award journey has more than one line to award.
Complete the pricing sheet for the line items.
Commit a bidding schedule required for publication.
Invite one QA vendor, matching the single-vendor award scenario.
Publish the event so the vendor can bid.
Verify that publication reached a real project page.
Have the invited vendor submit a bid.
Verify that the vendor bid was accepted.
Close bidding before starting the award.
Submit the award proposal using the configured entire-lot-to-one-vendor rule.
Verify that the award proposal was created and submitted.
